description: Marlow Capital Pte. Ltd. is incorporated in Singapore. It is wholly owned by Marlow Holdings Limited, a Hong Kong company, since 2 May 2020. In 2025 Marlow Capital lent SGD 5,000,000 to Marlow Holdings at 5% a year under a written loan agreement dated 1 January 2025. On 31 December 2026 Marlow Holdings pays SGD 250,000 interest to Marlow Capital. No tax has been paid on the interest. We have the loan agreement, the board resolutions of both companies and the audited accounts for 2025. Please assess as at 20 October 2026; all amounts in SGD.
